lessons_used: Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning the finish page showed no clear effect (-8.3%, p=0.106), and predictions (+7.0%) were too high.
Adding wait_info tips on the home page showed no clear effect (-2.1%, p=0.454), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.
Changing the layout on choose_path showed no clear effect (+1.5%, p=0.422), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Selection Split Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split view with live animated pet previews and distinct choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) with custom generation bugs and high decision time (mean 1017s).

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet template or custom path with live animation previews.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of pet selection screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and long duration, but layout redesigns showed mixed results in past tests.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Visual Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a new confirmation step after photo upload to preview and verify custom pet rendering before adoption.
candidates.why: Support receives tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong after photo upload.

new_pet_preview.headline: Verify Your Custom Pet
new_pet_preview.body: Review how your custom pet will render on your desktop before final adoption.

guard.reason: Valid new confirmation screen added within onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel drop-off and support tickets point to custom pet issues, but adding a new screen increases friction.

candidates.title: Animated Stage Waiting Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a interactive stage layout with time estimates and mascot animation.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean 2336s, leading to drop-off or suspected app freezing.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Environment
waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready to move onto your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of waiting screen keeping its core job.

candidates.score_note: Home step wait tips previously failed to produce positive lift (-2.1%), making flow overhauls risky.

candidates.title: Bond First Sign In Later Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in after picking a pet companion so users form an emotional connection before account creation.
candidates.why: Early drop-off is high, and letting users choose their pet before account setup increases intent.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step permitted by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting early funnel drop-off by deferring sign-in can boost intent, though it requires significant structural changes.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidance
candidates.change: Add clear instructions on photo lighting and single-subject framing on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Users report failed or distorted custom pet renders during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Single-Subject Photos
upload_photos.body: For best pet rendering results, upload a well-lit photo of one pet looking directly at the camera.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry images, group photos, or low lighting to prevent generation errors.

guard.reason: Valid copy guidance update on photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and funnel data; low-cost copy guidance can directly resolve pet render failures.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit usage hints on the finish screen explaining how to summon, hide, and right-click the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails report confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet or system tray icon anytime to open controls or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses explicit support feedback via low-cost hints, though finish screen changes showed weak results previously.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Clarification Notice
candidates.change: Add persistent notice on sign-in clarifying that using the existing email account restores missing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing back in? Use your existing account email to instantly restore all saved pets and progress.

candidates.why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates hesitation due to fear of permanent commitment.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry about picking the wrong path—you can change or add new pets anytime in settings.

picked: Bond First Sign In Later Reorder

decisions.title: Bond First Sign In Later Reorder

lessons_next: Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predictions (+10.0%) were slightly too high.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8%), and predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns, hints) showed no clear effect, and predictions were consistently too high.
Adding tips carousels or waiting flows on the home page showed no clear effect, and predictions were too high.
Layout changes on the choose_path page showed no clear effect (+1.5%), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.
